title: aneilema lanceolatum subsp. subnudum
intro: Aneilema lanceolatum subsp. subnudum, commonly known as the Naked Aneilema, is a plant species in the Aneilema genus. The Naked Aneilema has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory symptoms. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, although further research is required to confirm the exact mechanisms of action.
